login.title: Connect your camera
login.intro: Use the Camera Account you created in the Tapo app.
login.cloudToggle: My Tapo app password is different
login.help1: In the Tapo app, open the camera, then Settings, Advanced settings, Camera Account.
login.help2: Create a username and password there. That is the Camera Account.
login.help3: The camera and this PC must be on the same network.
login.missing: Enter the camera IP address, username and password.
login.testOk: Camera found. Live video and the control connection both answer.
login.testNoVideo: Something answers there, but not on the live video port. Check that it is the camera.
login.testNoControl: Live video answers, but the control connection does not. Recordings may not load.
login.testNone: Nothing answered at that address. Check the IP in the Tapo app under Device info.
login.help4: The camera IP is in the Tapo app: open the camera, then Settings, Device info.
login.signingIn: Signing in. This can take up to 30 seconds.

camera.livePaused: Live view is paused while a recording downloads.
camera.waitingClip: Waiting for the current download to finish…
camera.externalTip: For the smoothest playback with sound, open this recording in VLC or another video player.

clips.title: {date}
clips.emptyHint: Pick a day with a mark under it.
clips.emptyFilter: No recordings of this kind on this day.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.emptyHint: Choose a recording on the Camera page and select Download.
downloads.oneAtATime: The camera sends one recording at a time, so downloads wait their turn.

problems.title: Problems
problems.intro: What went wrong, in plain words, and what to try.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: To add a language, open the language folder, copy _template.json to a new name such as de.json, translate the text and restart the app.
settings.cacheHint: Recordings you watched and detection images, so they open again without asking the camera. Kept under 1 GB; the oldest go first.
settings.checkOnStart: Check for a new version when the app opens
settings.checkFailed: Could not reach GitHub. Try again later.
settings.privacy: The check asks GitHub for the latest release. It sends no camera details.

update.body: You have {current}. Download the new version from GitHub and replace this file.

ERR_INPUT.title: Something is missing
ERR_INPUT.explanation: Enter the camera IP address, the Camera Account username and its password.

ERR_CLOUD_AUTH.title: The camera did not accept the login
ERR_CLOUD_AUTH.explanation: Both ways of signing in were refused. Many cameras want your Tapo app password here, not only the Camera Account password.
steps: Tick “My Tapo app password is different” and enter the password you use in the Tapo app.
Check the Camera Account username and password in the Tapo app.
Wait a minute between tries. Too many wrong tries lock the camera for a while.

ERR_CAMERA_LOCKED.title: The camera is locked for a few minutes
ERR_CAMERA_LOCKED.explanation: After several wrong passwords the camera stops accepting logins for a while.
steps: Wait several minutes without trying again. Each try restarts the wait.
Check the passwords in the Tapo app, then connect once.

ERR_CLOUD_UNREACHABLE.title: The camera did not answer
ERR_CLOUD_UNREACHABLE.explanation: The PC could not reach the camera's control connection.
steps: Check the IP address in the Tapo app under Device info.
Make sure this PC and the camera are on the same Wi-Fi or network.
Allow TapFeed through Windows Firewall or your antivirus.

ERR_CLOUD_UNKNOWN.title: The camera gave an answer the app does not understand
ERR_CLOUD_UNKNOWN.explanation: This can happen with very new camera firmware or while the camera restarts.
steps: Wait a minute and connect again.
If you have a separate Tapo app password, enter it.
If it keeps happening, copy the technical details and report it on GitHub.

ERR_CONNECT_FAILED.title: Could not connect to the camera
ERR_CONNECT_FAILED.explanation: The connection failed for a reason the app could not pin down.
steps: Try again.
Restart the camera if it keeps failing.

ERR_BAD_HOST.title: That IP address does not look right
ERR_BAD_HOST.explanation: Enter only the numbers, like 192.168.0.103, without http:// or a port.

ERR_CAMERA_TIMEOUT.title: The camera took too long to answer
ERR_CAMERA_TIMEOUT.explanation: The camera may be busy, restarting or far from the router.
steps: Wait a moment and try again.
Move the camera closer to the router or restart it.

ERR_CAMERA_UNREACHABLE.title: No camera at that address
ERR_CAMERA_UNREACHABLE.explanation: Nothing answered at that IP address within a few seconds.
steps: Check the IP address in the Tapo app: camera, Settings, Device info.
Make sure the camera is on and on the same network as this PC.
Select Test beside the IP address to check again.

ERR_RTSP_AUTH.title: Live view login was refused
ERR_RTSP_AUTH.explanation: The camera rejected the Camera Account username or password for live video.
steps: Check the Camera Account in the Tapo app: camera, Settings, Advanced settings, Camera Account.
Sign out and sign in again with the corrected password.

ERR_RTSP_REFUSED.title: The camera refused live video
ERR_RTSP_REFUSED.explanation: The camera's video port (554) did not accept the connection.
steps: Restart the camera.
Make sure no firewall blocks port 554.

ERR_LIVE_REJECTED.title: Live video did not start
ERR_LIVE_REJECTED.explanation: The camera did not send a video stream.
steps: Try SD quality.
Close other apps that watch this camera, then start live view again.

ERR_PLAYBACK_OPEN.title: This recording could not be played
ERR_PLAYBACK_OPEN.explanation: The file is missing or damaged.
steps: Download the recording again.

ERR_PLAYBACK.title: Playback stopped
ERR_PLAYBACK.explanation: The player could not carry out that action.
steps: Try again.

ERR_PLAYER_START.title: The video player could not start
ERR_PLAYER_START.explanation: Part of the app could not be unpacked or loaded on this PC.
steps: Close TapFeed and open it again.
Make sure your antivirus did not block or remove files in the app data folder.

ERR_PLAYER_STARTING.title: The player is still starting
ERR_PLAYER_STARTING.explanation: Give it a second and try again.

ERR_FILE_MISSING.title: The file is gone
ERR_FILE_MISSING.explanation: It was moved or deleted after it was downloaded.
steps: Download the recording again.

ERR_NOT_CONNECTED.title: Not connected
ERR_NOT_CONNECTED.explanation: Sign in to the camera first.

ERR_SD_NOT_AUTHENTICATED.title: Not connected to the camera
ERR_SD_NOT_AUTHENTICATED.explanation: The connection to the camera's recordings was lost.
steps: Sign out and sign in again.

ERR_NO_SD_CARD.title: No memory card found
ERR_NO_SD_CARD.explanation: The camera has no microSD card, or it is not formatted.
steps: Check the card in the Tapo app under Storage and recording.

ERR_SD_LOADING.title: The memory card is still loading
ERR_SD_LOADING.explanation: The camera is reading its microSD card after a restart.
steps: Wait a minute, then select Refresh.

ERR_CAMERA_BUSY.title: The camera is busy
ERR_CAMERA_BUSY.explanation: Another app or phone is already playing a recording from this camera.
steps: Close recording playback in the Tapo app on your phone.
Try again in a minute.

ERR_SESSION_EXPIRED.title: The camera ended the session
ERR_SESSION_EXPIRED.explanation: This happens after a while, or when the camera restarts.
steps: Sign out and sign in again.

ERR_RECORDINGS_FAILED.title: Could not load recordings
ERR_RECORDINGS_FAILED.explanation: The camera did not send the list of recordings.
steps: Select Refresh.
Sign out and sign in again if it keeps failing.

ERR_REFRESH_FAILED.title: Could not refresh
ERR_REFRESH_FAILED.explanation: The camera did not send the list of recording days.
steps: Try again in a moment.

ERR_DOWNLOAD_EMPTY.title: The camera sent no video for this recording
ERR_DOWNLOAD_EMPTY.explanation: The recording may still be in progress, or it was overwritten on the card.
steps: Wait until the recording ends, then try again.
Pick another recording.

ERR_DOWNLOAD_FAILED.title: The download failed
ERR_DOWNLOAD_FAILED.explanation: The camera stopped sending the recording.
steps: Select Retry.

ERR_DOWNLOAD_NETWORK.title: The connection dropped during the download
ERR_DOWNLOAD_NETWORK.explanation: The Wi-Fi link to the camera was interrupted.
steps: Select Retry.
Move the camera closer to the router.

ERR_DISK_FULL.title: The disk is full
ERR_DISK_FULL.explanation: There is no space left in the downloads folder.
steps: Free some space, or choose another folder in Settings.

ERR_STORAGE_PERM.title: That folder cannot be used
ERR_STORAGE_PERM.explanation: The app is not allowed to save files there.
steps: Choose a folder you own, such as one in Documents.

ERR_CREDENTIAL_STORE.title: The password could not be remembered
ERR_CREDENTIAL_STORE.explanation: Windows Credential Manager refused to save it. You are still connected.
steps: Untick “Remember on this PC”, or check Credential Manager in Windows settings.

ERR_HELPER_START.title: The camera connection could not start
ERR_HELPER_START.explanation: Part of the app could not be unpacked or was blocked on this PC.
steps: Close TapFeed and open it again.
Check that your antivirus did not quarantine tapo-helper.exe.

ERR_HELPER_STOPPED.title: The camera connection stopped
ERR_HELPER_STOPPED.explanation: The part of the app that talks to the camera closed unexpectedly.
steps: Sign out and sign in again.

ERR_UPDATE_CHECK.title: Could not check for updates
steps: Check your internet connection and try again later.

ERR_SETTINGS.title: Settings could not be saved
ERR_SETTINGS.explanation: The settings file could not be written.
steps: Close other copies of TapFeed and try again.

ERR_UNKNOWN.title: Something went wrong
ERR_UNKNOWN.explanation: The app could not tell exactly what happened.
steps: Try again.
If it keeps happening, copy the technical details and report it on GitHub.

ERR_SCREENSHOT.title: The screenshot was not saved
ERR_SCREENSHOT.explanation: The picture could not be written to the downloads folder.
steps: Check that the downloads folder exists and has free space, in Settings.

ERR_NOTHING_PLAYING.title: Nothing is playing
ERR_NOTHING_PLAYING.explanation: Start live view or play a recording, then take the screenshot.

ERR_PTZ_UNSUPPORTED.title: This camera cannot turn
ERR_PTZ_UNSUPPORTED.explanation: It has no pan and tilt motor, so movement controls are hidden.

ERR_PTZ_MOVE.title: The camera did not move
ERR_PTZ_MOVE.explanation: It may be at the end of its range, or busy.
steps: Try the other direction.
Wait a moment and try again.

about.title: About
about.intro: TapFeed shows your Tapo camera live and lets you browse, play and save its memory card recordings.

about.bugs: Found a bug? Open the issues page and select New issue.
